criteria_results.text: Every dedicated tool screen handles loading, empty, secret-free offline cache, forbidden, expired-auth, and retryable server error with accessible Dynamic Type and dark-mode-safe UI.
criteria_results.notes: The corrective source contract passed 2/2. A rebuilt iOS 18.3 iPhone SE development client in dark appearance at accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large rendered the expanded Webhook card with content-measured title, URL, and action sections. The native accessibility snapshot exposed Copy URL, Rotate secret, and Delete as reachable buttons.

issues.description: The corrective native smoke completed before the aggregate branch verification-gate and project-state-updater passes, which remain required before push.
